title: Unsweetened Applesauce with Added Vitamin C

content.title: About
content.content: Unsweetened applesauce is a pure fruit product made from selected apple varieties, steamed and pureed to a smooth consistency. Vitamin C (ascorbic acid) is added to boost antioxidant properties and support immune health.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Applesauce retains most of the fiber and vitamins of the original apples.
The added vitamin C is stabilized, so its level remains high even after extended storage.
Without added sugar, the sauce has a natural sweet‑tart flavor typical of ripe apples.
Apples are one of the oldest cultivated plants; domestication began over 4,000 years ago.
The sauce is convenient for baby foods because it is easy to digest and free of common allergens like nuts or dairy.

items.title: Rich in dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber supports regular bowel movements and promotes a feeling of fullness.

items.title: Source of vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C enhances immune defense, participates in collagen synthesis, and acts as an antioxidant.

items.title: Low in added sugar
items.content: The absence of added sugar makes the sauce suitable for people monitoring blood glucose levels.

items.title: Contains potassium
items.content: Potassium helps maintain fluid‑electrolyte balance and normal blood pressure.

items.title: Easy to digest
items.content: The smooth texture makes it suitable for children and individuals with chewing difficulties.

items.title: Apple allergy
items.content: A small number of people may experience allergic reactions to apple proteins or related compounds.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: High acidity may irritate the stomach lining in individuals with gastritis or ulcers.

items.title: Vitamin C content
items.content: Excessive intake of added vitamin C can cause gastrointestinal discomfort.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Applesauce can be enjoyed on its own, mixed into oatmeal, yogurt, smoothies, baked goods, or used as a base for baby meals.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the sauce in the refrigerator at 0 °C–4 °C in a sealed package for up to 7 days. After opening, transfer to an airtight container. When frozen, it keeps quality for up to 3 months.
